description: Unique name
Name of bus to which the synchronous condenser is attached.

Q,V control strategy for power flow, must be "PQ" or "PV". With "PV" the condenser controls the voltage magnitude of its bus to `v_mag_pu_set` of the bus and its reactive power follows from the power flow. Only relevant for "AC" buses.
Carrier of the synchronous condenser.
Nominal apparent power. Ignored if `s_nom_extendable=True`.
Nominal apparent power of a module (unit size). Introduces integer variables if set.
Switch to allow capacity `s_nom` to be extended in optimization.
If `s_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its minimum value.
If `s_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its maximum value.
If `s_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its value.
Minimum online capacity `s` for each snapshot per unit of `s_nom` in the optimization.
Maximum online capacity `s` for each snapshot per unit of `s_nom` in the optimization (e.g. availability).
Online capacity set point (for optimization).
Active power set point for power flow, negative for the consumption of losses. Set by `n.optimize.fix_optimal_dispatch()` to the optimised `p`.
Reactive power set point for power flow if `control` is `PQ` (positive if generating).
Sign denoting the orientation of the dispatch variable (positive for generation, negative for consumption).
Active power losses per unit of online capacity `s` drawn from the bus in optimization (e.g. 0.01).
Inertia constant H (MWs/MVA). The online capacity contributes `inertia_constant * s` to global constraints of type `inertia`.

Short-circuit power per MVA of online capacity, approximately the inverse of the subtransient reactance (1/x''_d). The online capacity contributes `short_circuit_factor * s` to global constraints of type `short_circuit_power`.
Cost of keeping 1 MVA online for one hour.
Whether to consider the component in optimization or not
Build year of the synchronous condenser.
Lifetime of the synchronous condenser.
Fixed period costs of extending `s_nom` by 1 MVA (e.g. annuitized investment costs). Used directly unless `overnight_cost` is specified.
Overnight (upfront) investment cost per MVA. If specified, PyPSA calculates annuity using `discount_rate` and `lifetime`. Takes precedence over `capital_cost`.
Discount rate for annuity calculation when using `overnight_cost`. Supports 0% rate (simple depreciation).
Fixed period operation and maintenance costs per MVA, added to annuitized investment cost.
Online capacity in the optimization.
Active power at bus (positive if net generation; negative for losses).
Reactive power (positive if net generation).
Optimised nominal capacity.
Shadow price of upper `s_nom` limit
Shadow price of lower `s_nom` limit
Shadow price of fixed online capacity `s_set`
